blog: Route blogging requests to writing, audit, localization, and other blog workflows.
blog-analyze: Score a post for content quality, search visibility, trust signals, and AI citation readiness.
blog-audio: Generate audio narration for a blog post.
blog-audit: Review a blog for stale posts, duplicate topics, orphan pages, and quality gaps.
blog-cannibalization: Find posts that compete for the same search terms and reader intent.
blog-chart: Turn article data into accessible inline SVG charts.
blog-cluster: Group related search topics around a pillar article and plan supporting posts.
blog-factcheck: Compare a post's factual claims with what its cited sources say.
blog-flow: Organize blog research, optimization, and publishing using the FLOW framework.
blog-geo: Assess whether an article is structured and sourced for AI citations.
blog-google: Report blog performance and search visibility using connected Google services.
blog-image: Plan and generate illustrations for blog posts through a configured image service.
blog-locale-audit: Find missing, stale, and inconsistent content across language versions.
blog-localize: Adapt a translated post's examples, tone, and calls to action for its market.
blog-multilingual: Plan multilingual blog output with language alternates and sitemap entries.
blog-notebooklm: Find source-backed answers in a user-selected NotebookLM notebook.
blog-outline: Plan a post's sections, word counts, FAQs, and supporting assets.
blog-persona: Define the writing voice, tone, vocabulary, and readability targets.
blog-repurpose: Adapt an article into social posts, an email, or a video script.
blog-rewrite: Improve an existing article's structure, sourcing, and search visibility.
blog-schema: Create JSON-LD structured data for an article and its author.
blog-seo-check: Check an article's title, metadata, links, headings, and canonical URL.
blog-strategy: Map audiences, topics, competitors, distribution channels, and goals.
blog-taxonomy: Suggest article tags and categories for publishing systems.
blog-translate: Translate an article while keeping its structure and metadata.
blog-write: Draft an article from a content template and sourced research.
